triplet: The Oath-Breaker, Cancel Promise or Alliance; words wind, paper burns.
songLine: The Oath-Breaker, Cancel Promise or Alliance; words are wind, paper burns.
reason: 'words wind' verliert die Bedeutung (Lore: 'Words are wind'); ein Verb ergänzt.

triplet: The Coup, Overthrow player with most points; Captain now until Lemurs hungry.
songLine: The Coup, Overthrow player with most points; Captain now, until lemurs get hungry.
reason: 'until Lemurs hungry' klingt gesprochen kaputt; Verb ergänzt, Komma als Sprechpause (Lore: 'Until the Lemurs get hungry').

triplet: Board to Death, Meeting: everyone gives card; email, but then eat you.
songLine: Board to Death, Meeting: everyone gives card; email? But then I can't eat you.
reason: 'email, but then eat you' ist gesprochen unverständlich; als Frage plus Subjekt/Verb ('I can't') wird die Lore-Pointe ('could have been an email, but then I wouldn't get to eat you') hörbar.

triplet: The Stool Pigeon, Name card, opponent discards; sing like bird for plea deal.
songLine: The Stool Pigeon, Name card, opponent discards; sing like a bird for a plea deal.
reason: Redewendung 'sing like a bird' braucht Artikel, sonst Telegrammstil mitten im Idiom.

triplet: Parental Betrayal, sacrifice lower card for higher; I can take you out for snack.
songLine: Parental Betrayal, sacrifice lower card for higher; I can take you out for a snack.
reason: 'for snack' klingt gesprochen gebrochen; Artikel ergänzt. Das Setup der Lore ('I brought you into this world') bleibt aus Platzgründen weg, die Drohformel 'I can take you out' trägt allein.

triplet: Mistaken for Betrayal, looks like attack, actually heals; why hitting me with newspaper?
songLine: Mistaken for Betrayal, looks like attack, actually heals; why hit me with a newspaper?
reason: Wörtliche Frage; 'why hitting me with newspaper?' ist gesprochen gebrochenes Englisch; Verb- und Artikelkorrektur.

triplet: Going Native, Adopt ability of player to left; shrimp better here.
songLine: Going Native, Adopt ability of player to left; the shrimp is better here.
reason: 'shrimp better here' ist mehrdeutig (Verb fehlt); Lore: 'the shrimp is better here'.

triplet: The Quisling, Help opponent against own team; new insect-eating overlords.
songLine: The Quisling, Help opponent against own team; welcome our new insect-eating overlords.
reason: Meme-Zitat ('I, for one, welcome our new … overlords') ist ohne 'welcome our' nicht erkennbar.

triplet: False Innocence Trick, Negate accusation; who me, just a lil' guy.
songLine: False Innocence Trick, Negate accusation; who, me? Just a lil' guy.
reason: Nur Interpunktion: Frage und Antwort müssen gesprochen getrennt werden.

triplet: Nasty Party, Lowest roll executed; Red Wedding catering exquisite.
songLine: Nasty Party, Lowest roll executed; Red Wedding catering: exquisite.
reason: Nur Interpunktion: Doppelpunkt gibt der Pointe die Sprechpause.

triplet: Prisoner's Dilemma, Snitch or Silent; if both talk, we cook.
songLine: Prisoner's Dilemma, Snitch or Silent; if we both talk, we cook.
reason: 'if both talk, we cook' – Subjekt fehlt, Logik des Dilemmas geht verloren.

triplet: I Surrender, Suckers!, Cancel combat, then double damage; white flag, just napkin.
songLine: I Surrender, Suckers! Cancel combat, then double damage; white flag? Just a napkin.
reason: Satzzeichen-Kollision '!,' nach dem Titel; 'white flag, just napkin' als Frage/Antwort sprechbar gemacht.

triplet: Poisoned Chalice, Offer card, accept and die; toast to health or lack.
songLine: Poisoned Chalice, Offer card, accept and die; toast to health, or lack thereof.
reason: 'or lack' ist unverständlich; Lore-Pointe 'or lack thereof' wiederhergestellt.

triplet: Lying Finger Cross, cancel deal; doesn't count if digits intertwined. International law.
songLine: Lying Finger Cross, cancel deal; doesn't count if digits are intertwined. International law.
reason: Verb fehlt im Nebensatz; gesprochen sonst gebrochen.

triplet: The Scapegoat, Transfer damage to another player; guy with horns, I have horns.
songLine: The Scapegoat, Transfer damage to another player; guy with horns! Wait, I have horns.
reason: Pointe (Selbstverrat) kommt nur mit 'Wait' an (Lore: 'Wait, I have horns'); Ausruf statt Komma.

triplet: Shoot the Messenger, Discard card from their hand; bad news capital offense.
songLine: Shoot the Messenger, Discard card from their hand; bad news is a capital offense.
reason: Lore-Satz ohne Verb wird gesprochen unverständlich.

triplet: The Corruptible, offered card, join their team; I have morals, but really like mud.
songLine: The Corruptible, offered card, join their team; I have morals, but I really like mud.
reason: Wörtliche Rede; Subjekt im zweiten Teil fehlt.

triplet: Et Tu, Brute?, best friend attacks, instantly wins; you die of heartbreak. Then fall, Fido.
songLine: Et Tu, Brute? Best friend attacks, instantly wins; you die of heartbreak. Then fall, Fido.
reason: Nur Interpunktion: '?,' nach dem Titel kollidiert gesprochen.

triplet: The Vendetta, Target player who hurt you 5 turns ago; elephants never forget.
songLine: The Vendetta, Target player who hurt you five turns ago; elephants never forget.
reason: Ziffer '5' ausgeschrieben (Suno-Aussprache).

card_title: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!
triplet: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal!, Betrayed, shout title, steal shoes
songLine: Curse Your Sudden but Inevitable Betrayal! Betrayed? Shout title, steal shoes.
reason: Nur Interpunktion: '!,' nach dem Titel kollidiert gesprochen; 'Betrayed?' als Auslöser-Frage abgesetzt.
